content.title: Dual Responsibilities | Independent Work, Shared Outcome
content.summary: Establish two roles independently through different tools, local actions, and intermediate results. Connect them at one shared interface where each contribution is indispensable, then end on a visible outcome that neither role could complete alone.

quick_start.input_format: Tools/operations/intermediate results of role A + different tools/operations/intermediate results of role B + shared interface + dual contribution results
quick_start.recommended_input: A copper-legged soil sampling automaton completes the mineral path, and a glass pumping station automaton independently builds water pressure; the two meet at a rectangular mixing valve, integrally starting drip irrigation and lifting the seedlings in rows.
required_anchors: Establish Character A through one stable tool, local operation and visible intermediate result.
Keep Character A's identity and result legible while its local operation completes.
Bring both roles to one shared interface where each contribution is visibly required.
Hold a concrete joint result while preserving both identities, tools and complementary responsibilities.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish two roles independently through different tools, local actions, and intermediate results. Connect them at one shared interface where each contribution is indispensable, then end on a visible outcome that neither role could complete alone.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish two distinct characters through separate, observable responsibilities before they interact. Give each one stable identity, tool, local action and intermediate result; only after both roles are independently legible may they meet at one shared interface where both contributions are required. End on a concrete joint result that could not exist if either role were removed, while preserving both identities.

invariants.rule: Establish Character A through one stable tool, local operation and visible intermediate result.
invariants.ablation_failure: A generic portrait provides no role for the second character to depend on.

invariants.rule: Keep Character A's identity and result legible while its local operation completes.
invariants.purpose: Connects identity to function before any team action.
invariants.ablation_failure: A prop held without consequence is only costume.

invariants.rule: Establish Character B later through a different tool, operation and intermediate result rather than replaying Character A.
invariants.ablation_failure: An identical second introduction feels like duplicated character art.

invariants.rule: Bring both roles to one shared interface where each contribution is visibly required.
invariants.ablation_failure: Placing characters side by side does not explain how they connect.

invariants.rule: Hold a concrete joint result while preserving both identities, tools and complementary responsibilities.
invariants.purpose: Closes the sequence as a dependency proof.
invariants.ablation_failure: A generic team pose or merged emblem cannot prove that both operations mattered.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is readable without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: carrier_or_token
slots.constraint: One visible material, prop or symbolic anchor that carries the causal mechanism.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: A sequence of visible, causally ordered changes rather than decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each change without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final state that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of visible-action sounds; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source white-haired and older long-haired characters
astrolabe, hourglass, masks and constellation-map vocabulary
source city triptych, circular camera rotation and split poster panels
the exact source red brush ring, character silhouettes and final game-PV diagram

instantiations.concept: In one continuous tactile greenhouse aisle, a copper-legged soil sampler inserts a mineral cartridge after testing a bed, a glass-bodied pump keeper separately primes water pressure, and both meet at a rectangular mixing valve; only their combined inputs feed straight drip lines and lift a row of seedlings.

instantiations.concept: In a dark practical-effects theatre, a shadow-puppet rigger tensions three overhead lines while a miniature lamp keeper independently aligns a moving slit light; both operations meet at one stage shutter and produce a readable flying-bird shadow that neither role can create alone.
